topics.topic: Classification of missing ProgressPhoto stored content during authorized binary delivery
questions: When an authorized, client-visible ProgressPhoto references missing stored content, is the failure a storage error or an unavailable/not-found failure?
When an authorized, visible progress photo references missing stored content, is the result the explicit unavailable/not-found failure required by A14 or the storage error required by R0-12?
When an authorized, client-visible ProgressPhoto references missing stored content, is the result a storage error or an unavailable/not-found refusal?

quotes: a photo whose stored content cannot be delivered fails as a storage error

A missing source object is an explicit unavailable/not-found failure and
  does not mutate the business record or fabricate empty content.
judgement.why: The passages assign different failure classifications to the same missing stored content of an authorized ProgressPhoto.

bases.passage: a photo whose stored content cannot be delivered fails as a storage error

A missing source object is an explicit unavailable/not-found failure and
  does not mutate the business record or fabricate empty content.

unsupported_sides: a photo whose stored content cannot be delivered fails as a storage error

A missing source object is an explicit unavailable/not-found failure and
  does not mutate the business record or fabricate empty content.

witness.initial: An active viewer has an active grant to an active project containing a client-visible ProgressPhoto whose file_ref resolves to no stored object.
events: The viewer requests the binary by photo_id.
The owning photo module re-checks project access and client-visible eligibility.
Binary storage attempts to resolve the file_ref and finds no source object.
outcomes: R0-12 requires the photo read to fail as a storage error.
A14 requires the missing source object to produce an explicit unavailable/not-found failure.
witness.observer: The binary endpoint and its authenticated caller observe the different failure classification and resulting error handling.
basis:
A client addresses a binary by portal-owned `document_id` or `photo_id`,
  never by `file_ref`.

The owning domain module re-checks authenticated project access and
  client-visible eligibility before storage access.

A missing source object is an explicit unavailable/not-found failure and
  does not mutate the business record or fabricate empty content.

topics.topic: Ownership of HTTP-safe DTO projection between use cases and the API
questions: For each HTTP-safe view or mutation result, must State 5 name that DTO as the use-case output and make the use case build it, or may State 5 return persisted/domain records and leave the API to build the DTO under the preceding api-only rule?

quotes:
The hash-free `StaffAccountView` of the new account, `pending_verification`
with no verified email.

A route handler extracts the
credential and the declared body, runs the route's `authorize` steps, calls
exactly one owning operation and returns its result or a safe projection;
it decides, retries and audits nothing.
judgement.why: State 5 names StaffAccountView as create_staff_account's output while separately allowing API-owned safe projection for operations whose declared result is not already the safe DTO.
